app.name: Saathi
app.ai_note: Made by AI. Please check important details.
app.prefilled: Saathi filled some details for you. Please check them.

ask.title: Ask Saathi
ask.label: Type your question or problem
ask.placeholder: Example: Rapido se 150 kamaye, or: Swiggy did not pay me ₹500
ask.no_amounts: I could not find an amount. Please say or type the amount, e.g. "150 kamaye".
ask.dropped: {count} item(s) were unclear and were left out. Please add them yourself if needed.

safety.title: Safety assistant
safety.intro: Ask about road safety, night shifts, heat, harassment, accidents or breakdowns.
safety.q_road: How can I ride safely in heavy traffic and rain?
safety.q_night: How do I stay safe when I work late at night?
safety.q_heat: How do I protect myself from heat while working outside?
safety.q_harassment: A customer harassed me. What should I do?
safety.q_accident: I had a road accident during a delivery. What should I do now?
safety.q_breakdown: My vehicle broke down at night on the road. What should I do?
safety.label: Your safety question
safety.empty: No messages yet. Pick a quick question or type your own.

schemes.title: Schemes & rights
schemes.intro: Answer a few questions to see government schemes you may get.
schemes.bank: Do you have a bank account?
schemes.needs_bank: Open a bank account to also qualify for: {list}
schemes.check_official: Check the official site before applying.

documents.title: Document help
documents.intro: Choose what you want to get. Tick each paper when it is ready.
documents.goal: What do you want to get?
documents.ask_placeholder: Example: My Aadhaar has an old mobile number. What do I do?
documents.pick_goal: Pick a goal above to see the checklist.

grievance.title: Complaint letter
grievance.intro: Fill the form. Saathi will write a polite complaint letter for you.
grievance.end_date: Last date (if it went on for many days)
grievance.description: What happened? Write in your own words.
grievance.description_hint: At least 10 letters. Do not write your phone or Aadhaar number.
grievance.placeholders: Before sending, replace [Your Name], [Your Phone Number] and [Your Partner/Worker ID].
grievance.email_to: Email goes to the official grievance address: {email}. Fill in your details before sending.
grievance.no_email: We could not confirm an official email for this platform, so use its in-app Help, or share or copy the letter.

escalation.platform_support: Send it first to the platform's support or grievance officer. Ask for a ticket number.
escalation.consumer_helpline: If there is no reply in 15 days, register a complaint with the National Consumer Helpline.
escalation.labour_portal: Labour ministry portal for wage and work complaints.
escalation.labour_department: Your state Labour Department / Labour Commissioner office can take up wage and work disputes.
escalation.women_commission: For harassment of women, you can complain online to the National Commission for Women.
escalation.police: If you were threatened, hurt or in an accident, file a complaint at the police station.
escalation.consumer_commission: If the problem is not solved, you can file a case online at the Consumer Commission.

validation.end_before_start: The last date must be on or after the first date.

ledger.title: Income & Expenses
ledger.privacy: Your entries are saved only on this phone. No login needed.
ledger.storage_error: Could not save on this phone. Storage may be full or blocked.
ledger.source_voice: Added from Ask Saathi — please check

profile.title: My Work
profile.intro: Tick all the work you do and the apps you use. Saathi uses this to help you better. It stays only on this phone.
profile.work_types: What work do you do? (tick all)
profile.saved: Saved. Your apps now show first in lists.
profile.onboard_text: Tell Saathi what work you do and which apps you use. It takes 30 seconds and you can skip it.

import.title: Import from screenshot or SMS
import.intro: Upload a screenshot of your UPI / Google Pay history or app earnings screen, or a PDF statement — or paste bank/UPI SMS. Saathi's AI reads it and shows every row for you to check. Nothing is saved until you tap Save. Files are not stored.
import.file_hint: PNG, JPG, WEBP or PDF, up to 5 MB.
import.text_label: Or paste bank / UPI SMS text
import.text_hint: Up to 5000 letters. Remove OTPs. Long numbers (phone, account) are hidden before sending.
import.too_big: This file is bigger than 5 MB. Please choose a smaller file.
import.low_confidence: AI was not sure about this row. Please check it.
import.needs_date: Date not found. Please add the date.
import.dropped: {count} row(s) could not be read correctly and were skipped.
import.none_found: No transactions were found. Nothing was added.

voice.no_mic: No microphone was found on this phone.
